english.title: Fail to comply within a reasonable time with a direction to remove / deliver a vehicle
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed to comply within a reasonable time with a direction to

(A)_[remove a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), under regulation 9(1)]_
(B)_[deliver into the custody of an identified person, a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), under regulation 10(1)]_

of the Road Safety (Immobilisation, Removal and Disposal of Vehicles) Regulations 2009
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 16 of the Road Safety (Immobilisation, Removal and Disposal of Vehicles) Regulations 2009.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
